notes.title: APEX Tournament is hosting an /r/IAMA
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31201496/a089f9f6de26c52bb9c7244d8dedc94707eb695a.jpg[/img]

[h1]
Developers will host a /r/IAMA at 7:00AM on Wednesday March 28th, 2018 till after release to commemorate the Oculus Platform release.
[/h1]

Good Day Competitors,

The developers are really excited to release [b]APEX Tournament on the Oculus Platform[/b] on [b]Thursday March 29th, 2018[/b].

For this FantomFathom decided to create an IAMA to answer any questions and recieve user feedback about APEX Tournament, our team and the future of our development.

[b]/u/FantomDev[/b] will be hosting the IAMA for APEX Tournament on [b]reddit starting 7:00AM on Wednesday March 28th, 2018[/b] and during the Oculus release. Feel free to ask any questions about our development and our team.

The developers will make sure to look through the question and answer as many as we can in a timely manner.

Keep on dashing,
@TheDude_Dev

notes.title: Update 1.6 BOTs are here!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31201496/6fa990a7ab5c249d2072429adc10c962b94a23cd.jpg[/img]

[h1]Single player bots are finally here. Use our unique locomotion system to outmaneuver and decimate the AI counterforces.[/h1] 

[list]
[*]BOTs will be automatically loaded when you enter quick-play 
[*]AI difficulty will increase after every bot is killed
[*]When a new player arrives the FFA will begin and the bots will be paused
[*]Try to get the highest amount of kills! 
[/list]

notes.title: Happy Luna New Year! 1.4 Update
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31201496/61f4061da4069e3ac5563b6bf0b7b9c5ba4ffb3a.jpg[/img]
[h1]Happy Luna New Year! 
Be sure to take advantage of our Luna New Year Sale. In this update we worked on graphics and game mechanics. [/h1]


Chop Chop Square and Critter landing got a graphic overhaul  
Collision boxes on Chop Chop Square and Critter Landing have been calibrated to fit better with the environment 
Aim on Assault Rifles and Sniper rifles have been adjusted to be parallel with the barrel 
Dash consumption rate reduced so overall gameplay is less punishing on map positioning

Also we are working on implementing voice chat. Please feel free to join our discord channel! 
https://discord.gg/ZXP32V

notes.title: Server and Game mechanic update 1.3
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31201496/9ca899be9f1186a85881e7d572a470001dc3d427.jpg[/img]

[h1]Hi guys,

Thank you for your support for the Apex Tournament. This update will introduce some new mechanics, game balance and quality of life fixes to support both our casual and competitive players.[/h1]

[b]Free for all cash flow balance: [/b]
When new players join an existing Free for All game an amount of cash will be give depending on how long the game match has lasted. 

[b]Automatic server queue allows players to be logged onto existing Free for All game: [/b]
When enough players are on the server a Team Death Match will be automatically queue for the players who want to join. 

[b]WarHammer Spike ability update: [/b]
Spikes comes out faster to increase the hit rate on the timed attack. 

[b]Kinetic Cripple Update: [/b]
Kinetic Cripple is given additional slow effect that make the sword more effective in combat. 

[b]Hyper Dash locomotion calibration room: [/b]
Now you can calibrate and adjust your Hyper Dash sensitivity from the main menu.
